config.cam3s_sawmill.title: Cam3's Sawmill
config.cam3s_sawmill.intro: Sawmill recipes are generated when data packs load: changes apply after /reload or when the world restarts. On a dedicated server, edit config/%s instead; the server's file is the one used.
config.cam3s_sawmill.recipe_mode.tooltip: Restricted: one plank gives only what crafting already gives one for one (two slabs, one button), plus one stair. Variants of the same wood only.

Vanilla-like (default): like the stonecutter, one plank gives one block that costs at most 2 planks to craft (doors, fences...), two slabs, or a block made from any planks (ladders). Trapdoors and fence gates are allowed too.
Extended: Vanilla-like, up to 4 planks of crafting cost (crafting tables, composters, signs...).
Rebalanced: recipes follow crafting costs and can use several planks at once, and make any item, including tools, boats and chests. Every mode turns one plank into two sticks.
config.cam3s_sawmill.max_discount.toolti: Rebalanced mode only. How much cheaper than crafting a sawmill recipe should be. Never more expensive than crafting.
config.cam3s_sawmill.strict_discount.too: Rebalanced mode only. Off: recipes stay simple, one plank for one or several items, or several planks for one item, rounding in the player's favor when the discount cannot be met exactly (composter at 10 %: 3 planks). On: follows the discount as closely as possible, even with odd recipes such as 7 planks for 6 ladders.
config.cam3s_sawmill.log_recipes.tooltip: Also generate logs to planks, log to stripped log, and log to wood (and back), all without losses.
